title: Is a Calorie a Calorie?  Processed Food, Experiment Gone Wrong
summary: Stanford Health Care hosts Christopher Gardner and Robert Lustig on whether all calories are equal, with a focus on processed food and sugar. The talk questions the idea that calories in versus calories out fully explains weight and health.
why: HN points to Lustig's talk when arguing that processed food changes metabolism and that a simple calories in/out model is poor.
